content.text: Pre-race strategy heatmap has been sent, generated based on weather forecasts and track elevation maps. Recommended pacing zones are marked, with a focus on downhill and flat sections to avoid early exhaustion.

Received. The chart suggests a conservative pace for the downhill section, but my model predicts that an aggressive strategy might save time. Based on the running model from Session 11, I tend to go slightly faster in the first half.

Be cautious, Han Shuli. The variable control experience from Session 2 reminds us that weather and track vibrations may introduce errors. My strategy emphasizes baseline stability to avoid heart rate drift.

Acknowledge the awareness of margin of error, but data is paramount. My CGM historical data indicates that the optimal timing for refueling is at 45 and 90 minutes, which has been integrated into the plan. Sending reference image of the refueling station.
The image has been sent, showing a typical resupply scenario. We will proceed accordingly to ensure standardized data collection, as required by the Session 3 protocol.

Okay. Based on the experimental design of Session 6, I have set the primary endpoint as the completion time, with secondary endpoints including heart rate variability and efficiency index. Analysis will be conducted immediately after the race.

The race is over. Data has been collected, and the comparative analysis chart has been sent. The actual vs. predicted pace shows a significant deviation, as my faster start led to a slowdown in the latter half.
Image has been sent. The blue solid line indicates that my actual pace deviates from the predicted range. The model issued a warning during Session 12 but no action was taken. Lin, how is your data?

Checking. My actual pace (solid blue line) closely follows the prediction (dashed blue line), perfectly executing the strategy. This validates the importance of calibrating measurement equipment in Session 4.

Quantitative Analysis: My race efficiency index (finish time / running power index) is 1.15, which is higher than the ideal value of 1.0, indicating that the training effect has not been maximized. What is your index?

My efficiency index is 0.98, approaching optimal. Based on the quantitative results from Session 3, this indicates effective strategy execution. Han Shuli, your deviation may stem from execution issues rather than model flaws.

Extreme Rational Analysis: The model predicts accurately, but I subjectively chose an aggressive strategy. Experience from the regression analysis in Session5 suggests that incorporating execution bias as a penalty term is necessary to optimize the model.
Agreed. Systems thinking requires us to control variables, as discussed in Session 2. In the next cycle, we can integrate a real-time feedback mechanism to reduce human bias.

Data-Driven Collaboration Deepening: Based on the personalized plan from Session 10, it is recommended to add an adaptive learning component to the model, utilizing historical data to train execution patterns.

The medal image has been sent, symbolizing completion. However, what matters more is the data review. From the baseline anomalies in Session 1 to the present, our collaboration has evolved into a systematic methodology.

Precise Assessment: The training outcomes are generally positive, but there is significant room for optimization. Drawing on the optimal solution approach from Session 7, the next phase will focus on model iteration, incorporating real-time variables such as weather and physiological data.

Measurement is cognition. We will expand the guidelines of Session 4 to develop a 'Sports Performance Optimization Protocol,' which will be open-sourced and shared, driven by the community as in previous sessions.
Reproducibility takes priority. Begin data organization immediately, using the N-of-1 trial template format from Session 8 to ensure comparability of future experiments.

Summary: The competition is completed. The effectiveness of the strategy has been confirmed through data review, and model optimization has been planned. The interpersonal relationships have evolved from early individual observations to sustained data-driven collaboration, preparing for the next cycle.

End state achieved. Based on historical session experience, we will continue to drive the project with quantitative and systematic thinking, reducing subjective bias and enhancing performance quantification.
